scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @seekdock/desktop typecheck
scripts.lint: bun x oxlint --deny-warnings apps scripts run.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.package:dir: bun run build && bun scripts/ensure-dsh-runtime.mjs && bun run --filter @seekdock/desktop package:dir
scripts.package:mac:arm64: bun run build && bun scripts/ensure-dsh-runtime.mjs && bun run --filter @seekdock/desktop package:mac:arm64
scripts.package:win:x64: bun run build && bun scripts/ensure-dsh-runtime.mjs && bun run --filter @seekdock/desktop package:win:x64
